verdict.rationale: Bevy has abundant public examples (docs-22,34,16) and an active community, but it is explicitly pre-1.0 with breaking API changes every release, and community reports cite limited/out-of-date docs and code needing rework across versions — a real caveat for LLMs trained on older APIs. missing for 10: stable non-breaking API surface, no llms.txt/official machine-readable docs, and confirmation that current-version generated code reliably compiles without manual fixes.
